rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; ABIDE I (17 sites) and ABIDE II (19 sites) combined, with some sites merged across repositories (e.g., KKI, NYU, SDSU, UCLA)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "ABIDE I includes a total of 1,112 participants (539 autism, 573 NAI) from 17 different sites, and ABIDE II includes 1,114 participants (521 autism, 593 NAI) from 19 different sites."

rci2_using_epd.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II used as the reference data for normative modeling
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "We combined the ABIDE repositories I (Di Martino et al., 2014) and II (Di Martino et al., 2017)."

rci3_epd_name.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II repositories combined; NAI from ABIDE used as reference cohort for normative modeling
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "We combined the ABIDE repositories I (Di Martino et al., 2014) and II (Di Martino et al., 2017)."

rci5_n.detail: Overall normative modeling NAI sample (males only); 90% (~670) used for training, 10% (~74) for testing. Demographics in Table 1 are for the pre-exclusion NAI sample (N=886); after normative-modeling-specific exclusions, N NAI=744.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "This resulted in a sample of 690 autistic and 744 NAI between 5 and 64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis" "The data set was split into a training set consisting of 90% of NAI and a test set consisting of all autistic individuals and the remaining 10% of NAI."

rci6_sex.detail: Primary analyses conducted in males only; females excluded due to scarce availability across sites (N autism=130, N NAI=280). Supplementary analysis including females used a separate model (N NAI=972).
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "primary analyses were conducted in males only due to limited sample size of females (N autism = 130, N NAI = 280). Analyses including both males and females can be found in the online supplemental materials."
